predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paper states that "at the completion of the experiment on day 28, the animals underwent behavioral assessments on day 29 and day 30." However, it also states that Morris-water-maze acquisition occurred on days 25-28 and that novel-object-recognition habituation occurred on days 26-27 with training on day 28. These are behavioral assessments/procedures occurring before the stated behavioral-assessment period, so the timeline is internally inconsistent unless the authors clarify that paragraph 8 refers only to probe/test sessions.

predicted_errors.error_location: Group allocation and quinacrine administration, paragraph 6
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Quinacrine groups received daily intraperitoneal injections of drug dissolved in distilled water, but neither the BDL group nor the sham group is stated to receive matched daily vehicle injections. Thus treatment status is confounded with repeated i.p. handling/injection and vehicle exposure. A BDL+vehicle group (and ordinarily a sham+vehicle group) is required for attribution of effects to quinacrine.

The same animals underwent intensive Morris-water-maze training on days 25-28 while also undergoing NOR habituation on days 26-27 and NOR training on day 28. Moreover, both the MWM probe test and NOR test are assigned to day 29. No order, interval, or counterbalancing is reported. Water-maze swimming/stress and prior testing can materially affect exploration and recognition-memory behavior, so this schedule introduces unaddressed cross-test confounding.

predicted_errors.error_location: Morris water maze apparatus description, paragraph 10
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The hidden platform is said to be placed "in the exact middle of one of the four corners" of a circular pool divided into four sections. A circular pool divided into quadrants has quadrant centers and boundaries, not four identifiable corners with an "exact middle." The platform location is therefore internally nonsensical and cannot be reproduced; the target quadrant/platform coordinates must be corrected.

predicted_errors.error_location: Tissue collection and histology paragraph following NOR description
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The methods say hippocampi were dissected from the brain tissues of "each sample" for biochemical analysis, then state that "whole brains ... of each sample" were preserved for histology. A brain from which hippocampi have been dissected is not a whole brain. The paper does not describe separate animals, separate hemispheres, or another allocation procedure that could reconcile these incompatible statements.

predicted_errors.error_location: ELISA procedures for serum IL-6/TNF-alpha and tissue hydroxyproline
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The authors state that serum or diluted tissue samples were used to "coat" ELISA wells and incubated overnight, after which enzyme-conjugated antibodies were added. The cited MyBioSource commercial ELISA kits are preconfigured immunoassays with manufacturer-supplied coated wells; samples are added to the supplied wells rather than used by the investigator as coating antigens. The same nonstandard sample-coating description is repeated for hydroxyproline. This is incompatible with the claimed use of those kits according to manufacturer protocols and makes the reported assay procedure unreliable/unreproducible.

The study claims assessment of phospho-Smad1/5/8 signaling and lists a total-Smad1/5/8 antibody, but says that all target bands were quantified only after normalization to beta-actin. Phosphorylation-dependent activation must be quantified as phospho-Smad1/5/8 relative to total Smad1/5/8 (with loading control additionally addressing loading), not solely relative to beta-actin. Beta-actin normalization cannot distinguish altered phosphorylation from altered total Smad abundance, so the stated analysis cannot support a claim of altered Smad activation.

Escape latency in the MWM was measured repeatedly in the same rats over four training days, and familiar-versus-novel object exploration is likewise paired within rat. The paper states only that these outcomes were analyzed by "two-way ANOVA," without a repeated-measures term, paired structure, or mixed-effects model. Treating repeated observations as independent violates the independence assumption and can produce invalid standard errors and p-values. The analysis must specify and use repeated-measures/mixed modeling (or an equivalent paired analysis).

predicted_errors.error_location: Statistical-analysis paragraph, MWM and NOR analysis
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paper proposes a two-way ANOVA for "the significance of variations in familiar and new item exploration time for each group." Because each rat contributes both familiar- and novel-object exploration times, object type is a within-subject factor. A standard between-subject two-way ANOVA is inappropriate unless implemented explicitly as a repeated-measures analysis; no such specification is provided.

Serum total ammonia is reported in "mmol/ml." This unit is dimensionally and physiologically implausible: mmol/mL is equivalent to mol/L, whereas ammonia assay outputs and serum ammonia concentrations are conventionally reported in micromol/L or mmol/L. The stated unit is a factor of 1,000 too large relative to mmol/L and must be corrected, together with any converted values.

The text calls "5601-01 Gateway Dr. W Thurmont, Maryland" a "catalogue No." This is an address, not a catalogue number, and no manufacturer/product identifier is supplied for the GGT kit. The assay therefore cannot be identified or reproduced as written.
